family_rules:
Warriors United is an adult community with good morals. Banter is welcome. These rules apply to everyone.

### 🤝 Golden Rule
Treat others the way you want them to treat you. Everyone has bad days. Do not take a bad day out on others.

### 🛡️ Rules
**1. No hate.** Sexism, racism, and discrimination because of religion or gender are not allowed.
→ Permanent ban. No warning.

**2. Swear with care.** You can swear. Do not swear too much, and never swear at a person.
→ A warning each time. We record it.

**3. No free Nitro posts.** We cannot verify these offers.
→ Ban. No warning.

**4. Respect privacy.** If a member asks you to stop messaging them, stop.
→ A warning.

**5. Follow Discord's rules.** All messages, images, GIFs, and stickers must follow the [Discord Terms of Service](https://discord.com/terms).
→ First time: 1-day timeout. Second time: server ban.

### ⚠️ Warnings add up
2 warnings: 1-day timeout
3 warnings: 1-week timeout
4 warnings: permanent ban, and removal from all family clans in Clash of Clans
wu_faq:

An English-speaking Clash of Clans family with members from all over the world. We have 3 clan types:
🎯 **Tactical:** serious wars. Plan, attack, and win.
🎉 **Flexible Fun:** relaxed wars. Play when you can.
💰 **FWA:** farm wars. Easy loot, low stress.

**How do I join a clan?**
Go to <#1553107113062965279> and follow the steps.

**How do I link my account and get my roles?**
Go to <#1114047624216068136>.

**How do I play CWL?**
We run CWL every month.
• **Main Clan CWL:** push for the best medals.
• **LazyCWL:** easy CWL with no pressure.
Sign up and see the rosters on the [dashboard](https://dash.warriorsunited.cc).

about_us:
We are an English-speaking clan family based in the USA, with Clashers from all over the world. You can play in wars while you upgrade your base.

**Note:** Our CWL clans do not support accounts that need a Family Friendly clan. If your account needs one, find a different clan family.

**What we offer:**
🛡️ 1 tactical clan
🛡️ 2 Flexible Fun war clans
🛡️ 7 FWA clans for farmers
🛡️ CWL every month, for everyone

**Funnies** `#2Q9RLRCG`
**For:** players who want serious wars and 3-star attacks.
**Requirements:**
• TH13 or higher, with your previous Town Hall level fully maxed
• No heroes upgrading during war. Wars are always at full strength.
**What we expect:** Follow the war plan and work as a team. Not every attack will be perfect, but always try for 3 stars.

**Warriors United** `#2YRVY8YCP`
**Arcane Oasis** `#Y2J0ULYR`
**For:** lower-level players and players who want relaxed wars. Wars are 50v50, or the largest size possible.
**Requirements:** None. Heroes are not required.
**What we expect:**
• Use your first attack in every war. There is no performance target.
• Relaxed does not mean inactive. We play to win.
• If you do not war, you cannot stay in the clan.
**Tip:** Heroes upgrading in the tactical clan? Move to a Flexible Fun clan for war loot. Move back when your upgrades are done.

**Clash of Thrones** `#Q889GPL`
**CoT Wildlings** `#2YJVQUCYJ`
**Four and Twenty** `#8CV0GPPR`
**The Horde** `#2RRCJCI0`
**PlaneClashers** `#9UGQ0GL`
**Edrag Rush** `#2PPCL2GYP`
**Wonder Wall** `#C002YRYG`
**For:** farmers who want loot from back-to-back wars.
**How it works:** FWA (Farm War Alliance) sets the result of each war before it starts. A simple war plan tells you how to get that result. Heroes are not required.
**Requirements:**
• TH12 or higher
• War weight of 115 or higher
• All buildings built for your Town Hall level
These requirements are a guide. Leadership looks at each recruit and makes the final decision. Your interview gives more detail about each clan type.
Select **I understand - Continue** to confirm that you read about our clans and the Family Rules. Then read the WU Strike System.
legacy_about_us_50e:
We're an English-speaking clan family based in the USA, with Clashers from around the globe. We use a game system that lets you take part in war while your base is upgrading.

**Note:** None of our clans is a Family Friendly Clan. If one of your accounts needs a Family Friendly Clan, join a clan outside Warriors United.

Here's what we provide:
:shield: 2 High-Level Tactical Clans
:shield: 3 Flexible Fun War Clans
:shield: 5 Official FWA Clans for Farmers
:shield: CWL opportunities for everyone
:shield: An Experienced Base-Building Team
:shield: Experienced Attack Trainers

**Funnies (#2Q9RLRCG)**
**WeAreBrother (#YQPYJCQ2)**

Our High-Level Tactical Clans require TH13+ and a fully maxed previous TH level, and they always strive to earn 3 ⭐ in war. Do not worry if you do not 3-star every time. Nobody is perfect. We expect our members to follow the War Format and to work as a team to win every war.

Wars are always at full strength. No Heroes can be upgrading.

**Warriors United (#2YRVY8YCP)**
**Noahs Ark (#8VPQCR2R)**
**Morning Woods! (#8VQP9VQ9)**

Our "Flexible Fun" Clans are relaxed Farm/War Clans that do 50v50 wars or the highest number possible. You must make your first attack. We do not judge your result. No Heroes necessary!

These clans are designed for lower-level, more relaxed players. If you're in a Tactical Clan and have one or more heroes upgrading but still want some war loot, move to a Flexible Fun Clan, then move back to Tactical when the upgrades are done.

These are not Camping Clans. They are competitive, and we want to win!

No War Activity = No Clan Membership. EzPz

**Clash of Thrones (#Q889GPL)**
**CoT Wildlings (#2YJVQUCYJ)**
**Four and Twenty (#8CV0GPPR)**
**The Horde (#2RRCJCI0)**
**PlaneClashers (#9UGQ0GL)**

FWA (Farm War Alliance) is an alliance of clans. The clans have organized wars, one after the other, for loot. The war result is decided before the war, and simple war plans tell you how to get that result. Heroes are not required.

Minimum requirements: TH12 or higher, a war weight of 115 or more, and all buildings built for your current TH level.
We look at each new recruit case by case. We explain each clan type in your interview. The requirements above are guides. Leadership makes the final decision.
